issues.description: Doc does not state that the agent stopped with stopReason give_up and that the 'Sign up' claim was therefore not confirmed reached; 'EVIDENCED' next to 'not_reached' could read as the claim being verified. The doc's wording is accurate to the CLI output but a one-line note that this is evidence-collected, not claim-confirmed, would prevent misreading in the PR body.
Total of 15 s excludes the 15 s app-own npm i; if 'fresh repo' is read to include it, total is ~30 s. Disclosed in the table, but the 'Total' row and line 21 do not say the pre-step is excluded.

Per-step times (3 s, 1 s, 11 s) have no retained timing log in scratch; only run.json durationMs (10.1 s) is independently verifiable. Also the doc does not record that explicit user approval was obtained for the key (packet step 1).
